entries.idea: The shipped bars (D51 line bar, D64 prop bar, D58 reasons) re-read with their error bars clustered by game (same-game bets move together)
entries.bar: A segment or reason on at full stakes under the plain error that is off under the clustered one is flagged; a rule is reverted only where the clustered replay's record (the bar's own place, replay-record.mjs barPlace) shows the rule losing units against no rule, else flagged in DECISIONS

entries.idea: Live routine props bet only in a late window before the start (D61's curve: value rises toward the start); confirmed by a research replay of the props placed at the intraday snapshot hours
entries.bar: Per sport, on the same prop keys: a placement hour H is no better than the close-only replay unless its flat ROI leads by 1.645 game-clustered SEs; the late window stands if no earlier hour leads the close beyond that, and is reported reversed if an earlier hour does

results.text: Research replay (optimistic: close-time facts): no hour beats close-only on the same keys in any sport; NBA early -20 to -38u, NFL noise (3h +2.2u vs -0.5u, SE 2.4pts), NHL close +38u vs +11-13u, MLB tie. The late window stands (bet as near the close as the runs reach).
